items.title: 29.6.1 Isotopic mass aur abundance (kitni miqdar mein milta hai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of isotopic mass and abundance (PDF 195-196).

blocks.text: Mass spectrometry se experiment (tajurbe) ke zariye isotopes ki relative abundance (baqi isotopes ke muqable kitna hissa) maloom ki ja sakti hai. Relative abundance ka matlab hai ke nature (qudrat) mein paye jane wale isotopes ke mixture mein kisi khaas isotope ka kitna hissa (proportion) hai. Maslan Cl-35 aur Cl-37 ki relative abundance respectively (bil-tarteeb) 75% aur 25% hai. Mass spectrum mein peaks ki height (unchai) har isotope ka hissa dikhati hai. Maslan neeche ke graph mein peaks boron ke isotopes ki relative abundance dikhati hain: boron-10 ki 19.9% aur boron-11 ki 80.1%.

blocks.alt: Boron ka mass spectrum: % abundance aur m/e, m/e 10 par chhota yellow bar 19.9 aur m/e 11 par lamba green bar 80.1.
blocks.caption: Boron ka mass spectrum (29.6.1 mein chhape spectrum ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Kisi element ka mass relative atomic mass (Aᵣ) ki shakal mein diya jata hai, jo us ke isotopes ka average (ausat) mass hai. Yeh isotopes ki relative abundance aur un ke masses se nikala jata hai. Isotope ki relative abundance ya to sawal mein di jati hai ya mass spectrum se parhi jati hai.

blocks.text_alt: Relative Atomic Mass (Aᵣ) = Σ (isotopic mass × isotopic abundance) / 100

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Har isotope ke mass ko us ke percentage se multiply (zarab) karein, sab ko add (jama) karein aur 100 se divide (taqseem) karein. Jo isotope zyada hai, jawab us ke mass ke qareeb aata hai.

blocks.title: Example 29.2
blocks.problem: Oxygen ka relative atomic mass, Aᵣ, do decimal tak nikalein.
steps: Given (diya gaya): ¹⁶O = 99.76%, ¹⁷O = 0.04%, ¹⁸O = 0.20% (neeche table dekhein)
Required (maloom karna): oxygen ka Aᵣ, do decimal tak
Formula: Aᵣ = Σ (isotopic mass × isotopic abundance) / 100

blocks.title: Example 29.3
blocks.problem: Boron ke mass spectrum se us ka relative atomic mass do decimal tak nikalein.
steps: Given (diya gaya): boron ke mass spectrum se ¹⁰B = 19.9% aur ¹¹B = 80.1%
Required (maloom karna): boron ka Aᵣ, do decimal tak
Formula: Aᵣ = Σ (isotopic mass × isotopic abundance) / 100

blocks.title: Aik aur misal
blocks.text: Chlorine (³⁵Cl 75%, ³⁷Cl 25%): Aᵣ = [(75 × 35) + (25 × 37)] / 100 = 35.5. Isi liye chlorine ka atomic mass 35.5 likha jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Gallium mein 60.1% ⁶⁹Ga aur 39.9% ⁷¹Ga hai. Is ka relative atomic mass nikalein.

items: Peaks ki height isotopes ki abundance batati hai.
